audit.whatIsWrong: The chart disagreed with the already-written neeko__yorick mirror, which sets row 0 to Skill, rows 1-5 to Neeko and row 6 to Yorick. This page read Neeko / Skill / Yorick / Yorick / Neeko / Yorick / Yorick, and whys[3] additionally credited 'your Maiden' at levels 4-5 when Eulogy of the Isles does not exist until 6.
audit.why: Neeko outranges the entire Yorick pattern for the whole laning phase — Blooming Burst at 800 and Tangle-Barbs at 1000 against a 700-range mark — and both of her damage spells get stronger off the minions and Mist Walkers Yorick brings. The lane only becomes Yorick's when the map opens and Maiden takes towers she cannot answer.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Neeko / Neeko / Neeko / Neeko / Neeko / Yorick across win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side as one paired group, ratings 5/3/3/4/4/4/7. whys[0], whys[3], whys[4] and whys[5] rewritten to match; whys[1], whys[2] and whys[6] already agreed.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] gave Yorick a Maiden at levels 4-5, and no spike carried a cooldown.
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles is the level 6 spike at 160s rank 1. Pop Blossom is 120/105/90s. Tangle-Barbs is 12s falling to 10s, which is the actual clock the lane runs on.
audit.corrected: whys[3], phases[3], phases[4], phases[5] and phases[6] rebuilt on the real timings, with the side-lane 2-item window named as the point it flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was absent everywhere: both of Neeko's damaging spells are made stronger by the units Yorick brings. Nothing on the page said so.
audit.why: Riot's Tangle-Barbs text: 'If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer.' Yorick's Mist Walkers are exactly the enemies it kills, so a Yorick who leads with the swarm feeds her root. Riot's Blooming Burst text: 'The seed blooms again on hitting champions or killing units' — the same swarm double-dips her poke. Second gap: Pop Blossom's preparation is hidden while she is disguised, so the tell is a lone minion or ally walking at you, not a cast animation. Also corrected: wants.you[1] told the player to 'Wall her R Pop Blossom windup', which the kits do not support.
audit.corrected: The Tangle-Barbs growth and Blooming Burst re-bloom now appear in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, dontsFull[0].d, phases[2].why and phases[3].why. The hidden Pop Blossom wind-up is in phases[4].why and spikes[1].text. wants.you[1] replaced with a verified line.

notes: Highest-value finding: both of Neeko's damage spells scale off the units Yorick brings. Tangle-Barbs 'becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer' when it kills an enemy, and Blooming Burst 'blooms again on ... killing units' — so leading with the Mist Walker swarm actively upgrades her poke and her root. That was absent from every field and is now stated in six. Removed wants.you[1]'s claim that Dark Procession can wall the Pop Blossom wind-up — nothing in either kit supports it, so it was replaced rather than kept. Kit flag misfire as elsewhere: yorick.json tags Mourning Mist (E) 'dash'; Riot's text gives Yorick no movement, so no dash asserted.
